people-ops: Quick heads-up  we're doing a short org swap in Platform Growth. Jordan Kim will move from Product Growth into Platform Growth as Head of Developer Experience, and Priya Natarajan will take a 6-month rotation into Product Growth to lead integration work with Dedicated customers. Effective dates: Jordan starts in-platform 2026-06-01; Priya rotates to product 2026-06-08.

Aisha Patel: Congrats Jordan and Priya! Recruiting implications: Platform Growth will open two IC backfills (DevEx SWE) and a contract UX researcher for 3 months. I'll post req owners today.

Diego Morales: Thanks  we'll need a short customer note about the Priya rotation since she's leading Dedicated integrations. I'll draft a 1-paragraph blurb for account teams.

Jordan Kim: Excited to jump in. Immediate priorities: docs triage for Quickstart, improve SDK onboarding flow, and a small audit of sample apps. Will hold skip-levels with DevRel and SDK this week.

Priya Natarajan: Happy to rotate  goal is to unblock two major Dedicated account rollouts and accelerate model-onboarding checklists. I'll keep a 1:1 schedule with Runtime and Platform leads during the rotation.

Evan Carter: Headcount check  are the DevEx SWE roles net-new or backfills? Budget owners need this for Q3 planning.

people-ops: Evan  both DevEx SWE roles are backfills (reallocated). UX researcher is a time-limited contractor (no HC). HC codes: ENG-DEVEX-303, ENG-DEVEX-304 (backfills).

Aisha Patel: Hiring plan: internal-referrals 3 business days, then external. Interview flow: 1) quick phone screen, 2) take-home (30-45m), 3) on-site tech + culture. Panel: DevEx lead, SDK owner, people-ops.

HiringBot: Reminder: add job tags "devex" and "dedicated-integration" in Greenhouse. Set internal referral window to 3 business days. Due: 2026-05-15.

Diego Morales: Jordan  can you prepare a 1-page transition note for your Product Growth projects? Share by 2026-05-20 so we can surface any risks.

Jordan Kim: Will do. I'll include TODOs, owner list, and a short `triage.sh` checklist we use for sample apps.

Priya Natarajan: For the rotation, I'd like a weekly sync with account leads and the Dedicated onboarding PM. Diego  can you intro me to the PMs?

Diego Morales: On it. I'll set up a 30-min sync and add the customer-impact doc to the shared drive.

people-ops: Onboarding link: https://redwood.company/onboarding/devex. Action items: Aisha post req owners; HiringBot will remind for rubrics; Jordan to publish transition doc by 2026-05-20; Diego to draft customer note and intro PMs. Congrats to Jordan and Priya! :tada:
